sources.finding: FastVolt exposes a public web page titled 'Carte des bornes' for rapid and semi-rapid chargers. The indexed public page contains a large set of marker/image entries, consistent with a national station map.
FastVolt states that stations are available both in the mobile app and on the website charging-station map, and that each charger displays real-time status: available, occupied, or out-of-service.

modeling.site_brand: station-specific; do not infer from FastVolt branding
modeling.app_source_access_network: FastVolt public website map and FastVolt app

tcc_relevance.next_step: Inspect only the public /carte page and its public client assets for a read-only station-marker data source. Do not authenticate, start sessions, or access account-only APIs.
